scientific_integrity: The exact formulas are derived from Fermi geometry, a coarea identity, one-variable calculus and a monotone likelihood-ratio crossing; reproducible independent polar-area integrations support them. The n=3 global law, the general fixed-polygon small-clearance law, and the inradius are prior results, not asserted new.
scientific_limitations: Curvature -1, regular ideal polygons, hyperbolic-area sampling and nearest-side distance; no nonregular-polygon distribution or uniform joint-parameter expansions. Priority is provisional and independent mathematical review is not performed.
title: Exact boundary-clearance law and a sharp side-count limit for regular ideal hyperbolic polygons
